scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:user && npm run build:admin
scripts.deploy:user: cd packages/user-app && npm run build && npx vercel --prod ./build --name semadaki-gozler-user
scripts.deploy:admin: cd packages/admin-app && npm run build && npx vercel --prod ./build --name semadaki-gozler-admin
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:user && npm run deploy:admin
scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:user && npm run install:admin
scripts.clean:all: rimraf packages/backend/node_modules packages/user-app/node_modules packages/admin-app/node_modules packages/user-app/build packages/admin-app/build
scripts.pre-prod: npm run clean && npm run install:all && npm run build:all
scripts.health: npm run health:backend && npm run health:user && npm run health:admin
